title: E0038: Method Call on Null
plain_english: Reports method calls on values that can be null.
why_matters: Calling a method on `null` causes a fatal runtime error. This rule uses Phanalist's bounded formal verification engine (Z3-backed) to detect feasible paths where the receiver can be null.
bad_example:
<?php
function name(?User $user): string
{
    return $user->getName(); // $user may be null
}
good_example:
<?php
function name(?User $user): string
{
    if ($user === null) {
        return 'guest';
    }

    return $user->getName();
}
what_it_checks: Method calls on null and nullable values
Nullness narrowed by `if`, `switch`, `match`, `isset()`, and short-circuit conditions
Nullsafe calls (`?->`) are treated as safe
